name: Gateshead Foodbank
short_description: Gateshead Foodbank at MetroCentre Baptist Church
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network. Emergency food parcels with referral. Open Mon and Thu 10am-2pm. Also operates at Birtley Centre on Wednesdays.

name: Gateshead Council Allotments
months: Birtley and Sheriff Hill. Plots from £25/year. Water and storage facilities available.

name: Gateshead Community Garden Project
description: Several sites including Windy Nook and Birtley. Volunteer-run growing spaces with seasonal harvests shared locally. Partnership with local food banks.
